unary_unary: build a gRPC unary-unary service handler that invokes an implementation function with a single request and returns a single response
unary_stream: build a gRPC unary-stream service handler that invokes an implementation function with a single request and streams multiple responses
stream_unary: build a gRPC stream-unary service handler that consumes a stream of requests via a handler and returns a single response
stream_stream: build a gRPC stream-stream service handler that consumes a stream of requests and streams multiple responses back
RequestIterator: review the _RequestIterator class that wraps gRPC request handling with Python iterator protocol support for streaming RPC calls
